interpretation.p10_conclusion: No single P10 delta reproduces the prior Full Enriched result in this four-cell structured ablation. Business Model most directly covers COST/RISK; Continuity covers post-decision abandonment; Accountability covers who-is-behind-this. The Full lift remains consistent with objection coverage across complementary gaps, not a proven single-cause effect.
interpretation.p02_conclusion: Authority wins ability/accountability signals, while Process wins next-step/decision clarity. Process is closer to the CTA decision; Authority alone is insufficient to explain what happens next.
interpretation.evidence_economy: Supported only as a conditional design principle: a compact, objection-matched core is preferable to volume, but P10 Full still suggests complementary coverage can matter.
interpretation.confidence: LOW_TO_MEDIUM; small structured sample, no live conversion data
